method.input: One normalized 224x224 grayscale plane; staged as FP16 without triplication. Existing RGB corpus channels verified byte-identical before qualification and comparison.
method.oracle: Unchanged RGB vector image ee1d8256... with the original weights, original 27 logical K terms, FP32 biases and FP16 tensors. Grayscale aliases logical channels to one physical input plane.
method.boundary: Preloaded normalized input -> all four heads. Includes host conversion/staging, two audited submissions and reading 512 bytes. Fixed parameters, image switching/sealing, file IO, camera preprocessing and accuracy comparisons excluded.
method.samples: Four crops x ten rounds, 40 timed frames per mode; order alternates RGB/gray and gray/RGB. Another 40 grayscale qualification frames reported separately.
method.limits: Host measurements overlap substantially; the overall host-wall medians show no material improvement. Paired median and mean differences are retained but are not treated as a demonstrated end-to-end speedup.
method.folding: Weight folding analyzed only; no weight changes made. Its coefficient-rounding L1 statistic bounds only that contribution for inputs of magnitude <=1, before accumulation/output rounding, bias and clipping.
